baseUrl.description: Prefix prepended to relative repo URLs (relative = not containing "://" and not starting with "git@")

defaultBranch.description: Fallback default branch for all repos; overridable per repo, usually omittable (resolved via origin/HEAD, then main/master/trunk probe)

name.description: Logical name, unique across the workspace; used by --repo filtering

url.description: Absolute clone URL (contains "://" or starts with "git@") or a path joined onto baseUrl

path.description: Checkout path relative to workspace root (no absolute path, no .. escape), multi-level allowed; defaults to repos/<name>

properties.description: Per-repo overrides, dotted domain-prefixed keys (e.g. "jdk": JDK spec used by executors like barista mvn inside this repo); unknown keys are ignored
